title: Find The K-th Lucky Number
summary: Given an integer k, find and return the k-th number that consists solely of the digits 4 and 7, represented as a string.
statement: Given an integer k, find and return the k-th number that consists solely of the digits 4 and 7, represented as a string.
constraints: Lucky numbers contain only digits four and seven.
Order them first by numeric value: 4,7,44,47,74,77,444,...
Return the k-th lucky number as a string using one-based k.
hints: Lucky strings form breadth-first nodes of a binary tree, appending four then seven.
The binary form of k+1 has a leading level marker; discard it.
Map each remaining zero to four and one to seven.
Binary counting lists fixed-length bit strings in the same order as lucky digits, while k+1 accounts for all shorter levels.
